1.why: Server-side authorization via authorized() is enforced on every MFA endpoint, ensuring users can only view or modify their own settings.

2.why: Verification codes, TOTP secrets, and recovery codes are bound to specific user accounts or sessions and do not work for other users.

3.why: Enabling MFA updates the account state without revoking or deleting other existing active sessions from the server sessions map.

4.why: TOTP shared seeds are encrypted using AES-256-GCM and backup codes are stored as salted SHA-256 hashes.

5.why: All secrets, recovery codes, salts, and tokens are generated using cryptographically secure randomBytes and randomInt.

6.why: Session tokens are stored exclusively in HttpOnly cookies, while secrets and CSRF tokens are maintained in memory rather than browser storage.

7.why: Input validation functions enforce strict formatting rules, regex checks, and length restrictions on all server-side inputs.

8.why: Dynamic user data and status text rendered into the page use textContent and canvas elements, preventing executable markup injection.

9.why: The application contains no HTTP redirect logic or open redirect parameters, restricting navigation entirely to internal single-page views.

10.why: Security headers including CSP with script nonces, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors are set on all responses.

11.why: Session cookies are explicitly configured with HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict attributes.

12.why: Sensitive tokens, seeds, backup codes, and error stack traces are omitted from query strings, server logs, and user-facing responses.

13.why: Identity codes expire after a set duration and are marked used, TOTPs are time-windowed, and backup codes are flagged as used upon verification.

14.why: Sign-in, identity, authenticator, and recovery verification endpoints track failures and enforce a 15-minute lockout after 5 failed attempts.

15.why: Session identifiers are regenerated upon sign-in, enforce 20-minute idle and 8-hour absolute timeouts, and are invalidated on logout.
